0022600175.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-6, 14th in the East) visit the Boston Celtics (5-2, 3rd in the East) for the eighth game of Milwaukee's season, with the Bucks on a three-game losing streak and 0-3 on the road. Boston is 4-0 at home and enters on a one-game losing streak, and the Celtics are missing Devin Carter, who is out with illness, while Paul George is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost the season series 1-3, including a 133-101 loss in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026.
